finalText: Migration finished and verified. All 12 stray `db.query` call sites (3 each in `sla.js`, `supplier.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `couponService.js`, `refund.js`, `returnService.js`, `session.js`, `shipment.js`, `teamService.js`, `cohort.js`) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. The unrelated `cache.query` calls and the vendored `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` (marked "do not edit") were left untouched. `verify.js` passes.
